CREATE TABLE analyses (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	trigger VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	symbols JSON NOT NULL, 
	summary TEXT NOT NULL, 
	sentiment VARCHAR(16), 
	confidence FLOAT, 
	recommendations JSON NOT NULL, 
	raw_data JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE broker_accounts (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	broker VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	display_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	config_encrypted TEXT NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_broker_accounts_user_broker_name UNIQUE (user_id, broker, display_name)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_broker_accounts_broker ON broker_accounts (broker)
CREATE INDEX ix_broker_accounts_is_active ON broker_accounts (is_active)
CREATE INDEX ix_broker_accounts_user_id ON broker_accounts (user_id)

CREATE TABLE chat_messages (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36), 
	session_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	tool_calls JSON, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_chat_messages_session_id ON chat_messages (session_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_chat_messages_user_id ON chat_messages (user_id)

CREATE TABLE conversations (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR(36), 
	title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	last_message_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_conversations_last_message_at ON conversations (last_message_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_conversations_project_id ON conversations (project_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_conversations_user_id ON conversations (user_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_conversations_user_project_updated ON conversations (user_id, project_id, updated_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_conversations_user_updated ON conversations (user_id, updated_at)

CREATE TABLE daily_pnl (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36), 
	date VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	realized_usd FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	unrealized_usd FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	auto_trading_halted BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_daily_pnl_user_date UNIQUE (user_id, date)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_daily_pnl_user_date ON daily_pnl (user_id, date)
CREATE INDEX ix_daily_pnl_user_id ON daily_pnl (user_id)

CREATE TABLE expense_transactions (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	external_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	account_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	merchant VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	amount FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	currency VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, 
	transaction_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	subcategory VARCHAR(96) NOT NULL, 
	occurred_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	pending BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	raw_data JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	synced_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_expense_transactions_user_provider_external UNIQUE (user_id, provider, external_id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_expense_transactions_category ON expense_transactions (category)
CREATE INDEX ix_expense_transactions_occurred_at ON expense_transactions (occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_expense_transactions_user_category ON expense_transactions (user_id, category, occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_expense_transactions_user_id ON expense_transactions (user_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_expense_transactions_user_occurred ON expense_transactions (user_id, occurred_at)

CREATE TABLE news_articles (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	summary TEXT NOT NULL, 
	content TEXT, 
	source VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	url VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL, 
	published_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	fetched_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	sentiment_label VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	sentiment_score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	tags JSON NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (url)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_news_articles_fts ON news_articles USING gin (to_tsvector('english', coalesce(title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(summary, '') || ' ' || coalesce(content, '')))
CREATE INDEX ix_news_articles_published_at ON news_articles (published_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_news_articles_source ON news_articles (source)

CREATE TABLE projects (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_projects_user_name UNIQUE (user_id, name)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_projects_user_id ON projects (user_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_projects_user_updated ON projects (user_id, updated_at)

CREATE TABLE reports (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36), 
	title VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	period_start TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	period_end TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	html_content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	pdf_path VARCHAR(512), 
	total_pnl_usd FLOAT, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_reports_user_created ON reports (user_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_reports_user_id ON reports (user_id)

CREATE TABLE simulation_results (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36), 
	name VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	strategy JSON NOT NULL, 
	initial_capital FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	final_value FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	total_return_pct FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	sharpe_ratio FLOAT, 
	max_drawdown_pct FLOAT, 
	trades_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	period_start VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	period_end VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	equity_curve JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_simulation_results_user_id ON simulation_results (user_id)

CREATE TABLE trades (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36), 
	broker_account_id VARCHAR(36), 
	broker VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	symbol VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	side VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	quantity FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	price FLOAT, 
	order_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	broker_order_id VARCHAR(64), 
	mode VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	reason TEXT, 
	pnl_usd FLOAT, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	filled_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_trades_broker_account_id ON trades (broker_account_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_trades_user_id ON trades (user_id)

CREATE TABLE users (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	username VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	password_hash VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	display_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	preferences JSON NOT NULL, 
	trading_mode VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_users_username ON users (username)
